limitations_and_findings.finding: Both accepted probes have empty unownedProcessesExcluded. Source code excludes unrelated native processes; no concurrent user-GUI exclusion scenario was actually observed here.
All four journals name the same host ECMCFS2. Second path with spaces was exercised; a second physical computer, new Windows environment, new Cadence installation or license was not tested.

Equal native geometry records cover component identity, pin net/positions, poses, layer/unit list, etch segment geometry, copper polygons and vias. They do not serialize every rule, property, non-target text, mask/paste or other native database field; no routing, DRC or fabrication acceptance follows.

Marker uniqueness/position is recorded by native d->text scan in both memory/fresh summaries and corroborated by fresh journal and distinct process. This read-only reviewer did not reopen or independently decode the binary board.

NET row contains the native n->pins member count, which is 0 in this fixture readback. This is not a connectivity proof. The 69 distinct net names and actual logical/physical pin-to-net identities were independently counted from their own rows.

Earlier relocated02/03 fresh processes exited 3221225477 (0xC0000005) with 526-character captured command strings; this correlates with a long path but does not prove a universal native length limit or spaces as cause. Final source has conservative prelaunch 500-character guard and ASCII path restriction.
